name: Texas & the South Plains
seasonNote: Come through Oklahoma and Texas in spring, when the bluebonnets are out, the Hill Country is green, and the West Texas desert is pleasant before the summer heat — a good window for Big Bend and the long western drives.
summary: The Lone Star State (with a start in Oklahoma): Tulsa and Oklahoma City, the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex, Waco, live-music Austin, the Space City and the Gulf coast at Houston/Galveston/Corpus, the Alamo and missions of San Antonio, the German Hill Country, and the vast west — Big Bend, Marfa, El Paso, and the roof of Texas at Guadalupe.
